name: stage-life
lua_assertions:
local p1 = _ITG_STAGE_STATS('PlayerNumber_P1')
local p2 = _ITG_STAGE_STATS('PlayerNumber_P2')
assert(p1 ~= p2 and p1 == _ITG_STAGE_STATS('PlayerNumber_P1'))
assert(p1:GetCurrentLife() == 0 and p2:GetCurrentLife() == 0)
assert(not pcall(_ITG_STAGE_STATS, 'PlayerNumber_P3'))
_ITG_STAGE_LIFE_RECORD(0, 0.5, -1)
assert(p1:GetCurrentLife() == 0)
_ITG_STAGE_LIFE_SEED(0)
assert(p1:GetCurrentLife() == 0.5 and p2:GetCurrentLife() == 0)
_ITG_OPTIONS_AT(1, 'ModsLevel_Stage', 'DrainSetting', 'DrainType_NoRecover')
_ITG_STAGE_LIFE_SEED(1)
assert(p2:GetCurrentLife() == 1)
_ITG_OPTIONS_AT(0, 'ModsLevel_Stage', 'DrainSetting', 'DrainType_SuddenDeath')
_ITG_STAGE_LIFE_SEED(0)
assert(p1:GetCurrentLife() == 1)
_ITG_OPTIONS_AT(0, 'ModsLevel_Stage', 'DrainSetting', 'DrainType_Normal')
_ITG_STAGE_LIFE_SEED(0)
assert(p1:GetCurrentLife() == 0.5 and p2:GetCurrentLife() == 1)
_ITG_STAGE_LIFE_RECORD(0, 0.25, 2)
_ITG_STAGE_LIFE_RECORD(1, 0.75, 2)
assert(p1:GetCurrentLife() == 0.25 and p2:GetCurrentLife() == 0.75)
_ITG_STAGE_LIFE_RECORD(0, 1, 1)
assert(p1:GetCurrentLife() == 0.25)
_ITG_STAGE_LIFE_RECORD(0, 0.875, 2)
assert(p1:GetCurrentLife() == 0.875 and p2:GetCurrentLife() == 0.75)
